source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.6.0, data build 946, released 2026-09-02

data.summary: Shown as Scouts X″. When pre-battle abilities are resolved, a unit whose models all have this ability may take exactly one of three options: a unit waiting in **[strategic reserves](vsdata:core-rule/strategic-reserves)** may be set up anywhere entirely inside your deployment zone; a unit entirely inside your deployment zone may perform a **[scout move](vsdata:core-rule/scout-move)** as 24.32 describes; or a unit aboard a DEDICATED TRANSPORT sitting entirely inside your deployment zone may have that DEDICATED TRANSPORT perform a **[scout move](vsdata:core-rule/scout-move)**, provided every model aboard it has Scouts.

options.action: set up wholly within own deployment zone

options.if: unit wholly within own deployment zone
unit embarked within a DEDICATED TRANSPORT wholly within own deployment zone and every embarked model has Scouts
options.action: that DEDICATED TRANSPORT makes a scout move
